pr.title: Core v2: Human Gate revision clears orphaned publication revalidation pointer
pr.body:
Shared Core v2 maintenance: fixes the generic lifecycle-integration defect where Publication Preview REQUEST_CHANGES to DRAFT_COMPLETE (or any boundary invalidating validation) left orphaned active publication_revalidation_provenance, making legitimate rollback impossible.

Semantics:
- clears only the active State pointer when the selected Human revision invalidates the validation checkpoint, derived from lifecycle keep semantics
- preserves active revalidation when validation remains active
- preserves immutable historical publication-surface-revalidation-rN records
- preserves fail-closed current-State preflight
- preserves Human Gate provenance and allowed-boundary semantics
- no edition-specific / W34 conditional

Regression coverage R1-R7 includes DRAFT_COMPLETE rollback, VALIDATED_DRAFT preservation, earlier-boundary clearing, corrupt-pointer no-write preflight, historical r1 byte identity, rollback-to-forward recovery, and later revalidation compatibility.
